title: Zeus common definitions
description: Identifier formats, scalar types and the error envelope shared by every Zeus wire format. Normative text: docs/spec/00-conventions.md.

Ulid.description: 26-character Crockford base32 ULID. The first character is 0-7 so the value fits in 128 bits.

SessionLeaseId.description: Handle for one release of session material (cookies) under a grant. Never persisted with the material; safe to log.

ArtifactId.description: One artifact record (13). Minted by the artifact store instance that holds the record; local to that store.

EventSeq.description: Monotonic event sequence number. Textual form (URIs, cursors) is ev_<decimal>.

Timestamp.description: RFC 3339 UTC instant, always with exactly three fractional digits and the Z designator.

Bytes.description: Unsigned byte count or offset. Bounded by 2^53-1 so every JSON implementation represents it exactly.

Hex256.description: Lowercase hex of a 32-byte digest (SHA-256 or BLAKE3).

Origin.description: Web origin: scheme, ASCII (punycode) lowercase host, non-default port only. No path, query or fragment.

Url.description: Absolute http(s) URL as received. May contain secrets in its query string: never log it, see 00-conventions section 8.

RedactedUrl.description: URL after the log or record redaction function of 00-conventions section 8 (no userinfo, no fragment, query dropped or sanitised).

ErrorClass.description: Coarse, stable failure class. The first nine drive retry policy for jobs (01-domain-model section 8); the remainder classify protocol-level errors.

ErrorCode.description: Stable machine string: <namespace>.<reason>, lowercase snake_case. Never translated, never reused for a different meaning.

message.description: English diagnostic for humans and logs. Never parsed. Must not contain secrets.

retryable.description: True iff repeating the same request, possibly after the delay or refresh the class implies, may succeed without human action.

details.description: Code-specific structured data. Optional. Must not contain secrets.
